summary.en: UOB Asset Management improved its AI hedging model with Vertex AI, reducing processing time from 48 hours to 2 hours and outperforming buy-and-hold by 28.75%.

overview.en: UOB Asset Management (UOBAM), a Singapore-based asset manager established in 1986, used Vertex AI to improve its proprietary AI hedging model. Processing time was dramatically reduced from 48 hours per trade to two hours. The enhanced model outperformed the buy-and-hold strategy by 28.75% and improved performance by 52.55% over the original model, potentially delivering close to an extra $10 million for every $100 million deployed.
overview.zh: UOB Asset Management（UOBAM）是一家成立於 1986 年的新加坡資產管理公司，使用 Vertex AI 改進了其專有 AI 對沖模型。每筆交易的處理時間從 48 小時大幅縮短至 2 小時。改進後的模型比買入並持有策略表現高出 28.75%，比原始模型性能提升 52.55%，每部署 1 億美元可能帶來接近 1,000 萬美元的額外收益。

en: Processing time per trade reduced from 48 hours to 2 hours using Vertex AI.
Enhanced model outperforms buy-and-hold strategy by 28.75%.
52.55% performance improvement over the original hedging model.
Potentially delivers ~$10 million additional return for every $100 million deployed.
F1 score improved by 1.86% and recall score improved by 4.77% to reach 92.11%.

summary.en: WealthAPI uses DataStax Astra DB with Gemini on Google Cloud to reduce financial insight response times by 90% and scale to hundreds of thousands of transactions per second.
summary.zh: WealthAPI 在 Google Cloud 上結合 DataStax Astra DB 與 Gemini，將財務洞察回應時間縮短 90%，並擴展至每秒處理數十萬筆交易。

overview.en: WealthAPI, a German fintech company, uses DataStax Astra DB on Google Cloud with Gemini to deliver real-time financial insights and personalized recommendations to millions of users. The platform analyzes transaction data using vector similarity search to identify patterns, such as recurring subscriptions or insurance payments, and provides timely cost-saving suggestions. Response times improved by 90% and the user base grew 1,000% in 2024.
overview.zh: WealthAPI 是一家德國金融科技公司，在 Google Cloud 上使用 DataStax Astra DB 和 Gemini，為數百萬用戶提供即時財務洞察和個性化建議。該平台使用向量相似性搜尋分析交易數據，識別模式（如定期訂閱或保險付款），並提供及時的節省建議。回應時間縮短了 90%，用戶群在 2024 年增長了 1,000%。

en: Response times reduced by 90% with DataStax Astra DB on Google Cloud.
User base grew 1,000% in 2024 while Astra DB scaled seamlessly.
Analyzes hundreds of thousands of transactions per second.
Vector similarity search identifies recurring patterns for personalized recommendations.
Delivers real-time financial insights and cost-saving suggestions to millions of users.
zh: 在 Google Cloud 上使用 DataStax Astra DB 後，回應時間縮短了 90%。
用戶群在 2024 年增長 1,000%，Astra DB 無縫擴展。
